description:
For current Hutsenpiller Insurance clients. Sends a 6 digit sign in code to the email if it
    matches a client on file. The reply is identical whether or not it matches, so do not tell the
    user whether they are a client. Returns a challenge_id for verify_client_code. The code expires
    in 10 minutes. A few sends per email per hour are allowed.
name: start_client_sign_in
title: Start client sign in
